During the summer months, all treated wastewater is discharged to the Facility's five percolation ponds.
Biosolids produced in the aerobic digester are discharged to two gunite-lined sludge lagoons for storage and further decomposition.
During the summer months, three sludge drying beds are used to dry biosolids pumped from the sludge lagoons.
Dried biosolids are transported to a paved, upper area, located northeast of the Facility for further drying before being hauled to an offsite landfill.
